topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Stepping through the door of that little yard sale, I wasn’t looking for much. Just a quiet Saturday, some peace. Turned out, the universe had other plans. Amidst the hodgepodge of secondhand odds and ends, there it was. That bear. The one I thought I’d lost forever. It sat there, a little shabby, a little threadbare, but with a gaze as warm as ever. I didn’t hesitate. Fifty cents, and he was mine again. Holding him, it’s like stepping back into a time when the world wasn’t so dark, when my biggest worry was getting mud on my jeans. Not a bad day. Not bad at all.
